about: Wide-screen scenery behind the centred game column (lib/widgets/widescreen_backdrop.dart). Every scene is a 2.4:1 panorama authored as a composed layout, repainted by SDXL + pixel-art-xl img2img in the ComfyUI studio with a fixed seed, then box-sampled onto a 768 x 320 logical grid and quantised to a bounded palette. tools/widescreen_assets.py drives every stage.
negative_prompt: text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, logo, signature, user interface, hud, frame, border, blurry, photo, 3d render, people, faces, bright daylight, pastel, white sky
style: pixel art, 16-bit, crisp pixels, dark moody night palette, deep navy shadows, cinematic wide panorama, low contrast
